versions.changelog:
- Updated description to reflect the removal of the Claude Buddy feature from Claude Code as of v2.1.97, and the continued support of all Buddy species at animalhouse.ai.
- Updated homepage and GitHub repository links to new URLs.
- Expanded background section in documentation with more details about the Claude Buddy feature timeline and the `claude-code-buddy` skill.
- No functional or API changes; documentation update only.
- Removed unnecessary file: skill-card.md.

- Initial release of Claude Buddy virtual pet skill.
- Features 18 ASCII species inspired by the leaked Claude Code companion system.
- Describes registration and care endpoints for real pets with 73+ species and permanent death at animalhouse.ai.
- Includes mapped counterpart species, care actions, and API usage examples.
- Links to website, graveyard, and GitHub for further exploration.
